_comment: Convex functions deploy with the site only when a deploy key is set. Without one `npx convex deploy` exits 1 and takes the whole build with it, so the site builds on its own instead — pages fall back to counting the reviews they fetch.
buildCommand: if [ -n "$CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY" ]; then npx convex deploy --cmd 'npm run build'; else npm run build; fi
